name: com.synap402/synap-mcp
title: Synap
description: Open-model LLM inference for agents. Pay per call in USDC via x402 or API key. First call free.

environmentVariables.name: SYNAP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Synap API key from https://synap402.com/account.html. Optional: without it the server pays per call from a wallet over x402.

environmentVariables.name: SYNAP_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key (0x...) that pays in USDC on Base over x402. Optional: defaults to ~/.synap/wallet.key (create with `npx synap-mcp wallet new`).

environmentVariables.name: SYNAP_SOLANA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Solana secret key that pays in USDC on Solana over x402. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: SYNAP_MAX_PER_CALL_USD
environmentVariables.description: x402 per-call spending ceiling in USD, checked before anything is signed.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Synap API key> (create one free at https://synap402.com/login.html; 100,000 tokens/day free)
